train_metadata.horn_status.notes: Acoustic spectral re-verification confirmed absence of pneumatic horn bursts (300-800 Hz). Only low-frequency diesel engine rumble (50-200 Hz) and ambient crowd noise observed.

timestamps.T0_first_visible.notes: Re-verified Frame 0 (t=0.00s). Left-censored: locomotive is already approaching under flyover at recording start (t <= 0.00s).

timestamps.T1_danger_zone_entry.notes: Re-verified Frame 174 (t=5.80s). Locomotive cowcatcher reaches turnout frog / pedestrian crossing clearance landmark. Note: Prerequisite R03 physical survey boundary uncertified; boundary reflects visual landmark.

timestamps.T2_crossing_occupancy_start.notes: Re-verified Frame 195 (t=6.50s). Locomotive pilot enters transverse roadway occupancy plane on front camera view.

timestamps.T3_locomotive_unit_clearance.notes: Re-verified Frame 216 (t=3.60s). Rear buffer/coupler of lead locomotive unit clears roadway corridor, transitioning to first passenger coach.

timestamps.T4_tail_clearance.notes: Re-verified Frame 2697 (t=45.00s). Trailing buffer of final coach (#7) clears crossing line. Immediate crowd ingress across tracks commences.

timestamps.T_scene_clear.notes: Unobservable: recording ends at 46.06s while receding coaches remain in frame.

camera_alignment.offset_s.notes: Prerequisite R04 inter-camera temporal offset remains UNRESOLVED without empirical hardware sync pulse. Front and back camera timelines verified independently on separate native clocks.

general_review_notes: Stage 2 Verification: All visual and acoustic boundaries for event_001 re-verified against physical frames. Candidate boundaries (6 accepted, 2 marked unobservable) confirmed physically consistent. Trailing coach count (7) verified.
